lessons.title: Reading: On the Nature of Wisdom
lessons.context: A closing reflective passage on wisdom, tying together the course's advanced themes.

paragraphs.uz: Donishmandlik yillar bilan emas, balki tajriba bilan o'lchanadi, deyishadi.
paragraphs.en: It is said that wisdom is measured not by years, but by experience.

paragraphs.uz: Ko'p bilgan ko'p yashamaydi, ko'p yashagan ko'p biladi, degan maqol bejiz aytilmagan.
paragraphs.en: The proverb "it's not the wise who live long, but the long-lived who become wise" wasn't said in vain.

paragraphs.uz: Har bir inson o'z hayoti davomida sinovlar-u yutuqlarni boshidan kechiradi.
paragraphs.en: Every person goes through trials and triumphs throughout their life.

paragraphs.uz: Aynan shu tajribalar orqali chinakam donishmandlik shakllanadi.
paragraphs.en: It is precisely through these experiences that true wisdom is formed.

paragraphs.uz: Ba'zilar bu yo'lni tezroq bosib o'tgani bilan, boshqalari sekinroq yetuklashadi.
paragraphs.en: Despite some traveling this path faster, others mature more slowly.

paragraphs.uz: Ammo oxir-oqibat, har kim o'z ichki haqiqatini topar ekan.
paragraphs.en: But in the end, it turns out everyone finds their own inner truth.

paragraphs.uz: Shu bois, boshqalarning yo'lini emas, o'z yo'limizni qadrlashimiz lozim.
paragraphs.en: For this reason, we must value our own path, not someone else's.

questions.question: Matnga ko'ra, donishmandlik nima bilan o'lchanadi?
Odamlar bu yo'lni qanday bosib o'tishadi?
